Now the root cause is clear:

- `ListOperationButtonContainer` renders the list title bar. It falls back to `$route.meta.title` (from router), appending "列表" if absent.
- The `buildingTableQuery/index.vue` page **does not use** `ListOperationButtonContainer` at all — it relies on `:title="title"` passed to `zs-search-form`, but `zs-search-form` has no `title` prop and renders no title. So the title bar area (red box) is empty.

This page also doesn't use `operationButtons`/`buttons` container. Let me verify the router meta title and confirm the page uses custom `buttons` (view only) rendering via `zs-operate-column` inline, with no toolbar buttons needed. Per user memory (`company_admin_list_fix.md`), the fix pattern is to add `ListOperationButtonContainer` with the title above the table.

The route meta title is `'项目楼盘表查询'`, which would render as "项目楼盘表查询列表" — but the page's own `title` is `'项目楼盘表查询'`. The box in the screenshot should show a title. Let me check how sibling `unitinfo` does it (it has `showListName` conditional), and check the router meta.

## 修复完成

**Bug 现象**：楼盘表查询页表格上方的标题区（红框处）空白，标题「项目楼盘表查询」不显示。

**根因**：
